Clans and social play

Using the clan shop: where do rewards go?

Open the shop from the clan menu and spend currency earned through clan activities and progression. Higher clan levels unlock more stock. Some purchases have weekly or total limits; check the remaining allowance first.

Rewards are for the clan. Resources go to the clan warehouse, not necessarily your backpack. Check the item description and warehouse, then have an authorized member withdraw them.
